decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The setup of the suspension has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team changed the setup of the suspension of Car 10 under Parc Ferme, this not being in accordance with Article 40.9 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. Car 10 is therefore required to start the Race from pit lane.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 10 Corrected Changes Made During Parc Ferme
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team
